# INERIM Interior
> Modern, premium and customer-focused interior design and execution brand in Bangladesh. Tagline: "Your Dream Space. Our Responsibility." Brand promise: "Quality You Can Trust."

## Overview
INERIM designs, supplies and builds interiors for homes and businesses. The design philosophy is modern minimalism, functional space planning, premium-looking material combinations and practical solutions for everyday living. Signature elements include walnut veneer and wood textures, fluted panels and decorative louvers, brass strips, marble-pattern surfaces, arch designs, glass-and-wood combinations, modular kitchens, wardrobes and custom furniture.

## Services
- Interior design and space planning
- 3D interior visualisation
- Modular kitchen design and execution
- Wardrobes and bedroom cabinets
- TV cabinets, wall cabinets and customised storage
- Living, dining, bedroom and foyer interiors
- Custom furniture design and manufacturing
- HPL, acrylic and laminate sheet supply
- HPL/acrylic board pasting service
- Decorative wall panels, louvers and selected finishing materials
- Aluminium profile handles and glass profile frame solutions
- Project-based material sourcing, installation and interior execution

## Packages (price per square foot)
- Essential: ৳1,350
- Comfort: ৳1,650
- Elite: ৳1,900
- Signature: ৳2,350

Final pricing depends on project type, dimensions, design complexity, selected materials, hardware, finishing and installation requirements. Full-apartment quotations are prepared project by project after requirement analysis and site measurement. Each quotation states whether electrical work, plumbing, civil work, countertops and appliances are included or excluded.

## How a project works
1. Requirement analysis: brief, budget and scope
2. Site visit and measurement
3. Design and material selection, with a 3D concept
4. Written quotation and approval: scope, price, exclusions and timeline
5. Confirmation and execution, with quality checks at each stage
6. Inspection and handover walkthrough

## Who INERIM works with
- Residential (primary focus): apartments, newly purchased homes, homes for newly married couples, living, dining, bedrooms, foyers, kitchens and wardrobes
- Commercial: offices, showrooms, retail outlets, restaurants, cafés, reception areas, workstations and conference rooms
- Partners: architects and interior designers, developers, material dealers and retailers, contractors and carpenters
